newsitem.title: USA: Automatic Data buys Staff Management.
newsitem.headline: Automatic Data buys Staff Management.

text.p: Automatic Data Processing Inc said on Friday that it bought Staff Management Systems of Florida Inc, marking its entry into employee leasing services.

"This acquisition represents a natural extension of ADP's services to employers," ADP Employer Services President Gary Butler said in a statement. "Through leasing, a company outsources its payroll, benefits and human resources responsibilities to a PEO (professional employer organization) which then serves as a co-employer to its employees."
The terms of the deal were not immediately available.
Employee leasing services are sometimes called Professional Employer Organizations.
Terms of the deal were not immediately available.

"Our strategic goal is to expand on Staff Management's position within the Florida market and to eventually offer PEO and related services on a nationwide basis," Brian Radin, ADP Division vice president of business development said in a statement.
Automatic Data Processing provides computerized transaction processing, data communications, software and information services to more than 375,000 clients.
